title: Suspicious Double Extension File Creation

status: test

author: Detection Engineer
date: 2024-05-21

detection:
  selection:
    # Regex matches: .<benign_ext>.<dangerous_ext> at end of filename (case insensitive)
    # Benign: pdf, doc/docx, xls/xlsx, ppt/pptx, jpg/jpeg, png, gif, bmp, txt, rtf, zip, rar, 7z, mp3, mp4, avi, mov, mkv
    # Dangerous: exe, scr, bat, cmd, com, pif, vbs, js, jse, wsf, wsh, msi, ps1, jar, py, sh, php, hta, cpl, lnk, scf, inf, reg
    TargetFilename|re: '.*\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|bmp|txt|rtf|zip|rar|7z|mp3|mp4|avi|mov|mkv)\.(exe|scr|bat|cmd|com|pif|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|msi|ps1|jar|py|sh|php|hta|cpl|lnk|scf|inf|reg)$'

    TargetFilename|re: '.*\.(tar\.(gz|bz2|xz|zst)|tgz|tbz2|txz|tzst)$'
  filter_main_dev:
    # Exclude common development/minified file patterns (e.g., script.min.js, bundle.js, types.d.ts)
    TargetFilename|re: '.*\.(min|bundle|config|spec|test|d)\.(js|ts|map|css)$'
